CHAPTER ONE: INTRODUCTION
1.1 Background of SIWES
SIWES was established to address the shortage of practical skills among Nigerian graduates and is a tripartite arrangement between students, institutions and industry.
1.2 Objectives of SIWES
i. To provide students with industrial skills
ii. To bridge the gap between theory and practice
1.3 Importance of SIWES
The scheme is important because it gives students practical exposure.
